authorship: Original English prompts, French example answers and brief teaching explanations created for this public workshop sample. No paid course prose or exercise export is included.

curriculum.vocabulary: 200 distinct beginner nouns and expressions, 50 per stage; stage 1 begins with the original workshop sentence about la maison.
curriculum.conjugation: 20 common irregular verbs, six persons and four indicative tenses: présent, passé composé, imparfait and futur simple. All selected compound-past cards use avoir with no preceding direct object.
curriculum.numbers: Metropolitan French. Four deterministic 20-item assessment samples cover cardinal numbers, masculine ordinals, dates and formal 24-hour times.

limits: These are constrained written recall exercises, not a validated assessment of conversational proficiency, pronunciation or long-term mastery.
Accepted answers are bounded and include selected common synonyms and spelling variants. An unlisted valid synonym may need review; the list is not a complete French semantic dictionary.
Vocabulary prompts specify definite articles; partitive or indefinite articles do not satisfy that exercise instruction even when they could appear in a grammatical sentence.

Conjugation prompts request only the conjugated verb phrase, excluding je/j' and other subject pronouns. This sample does not drill être-auxiliary agreement, reflexive verbs, preceding-object agreement, subjunctive or imperative forms.
Numeric exercises teach metropolitan forms; septante, huitante and nonante are valid regional forms but are outside the stated dialect for these exercises.
Stage samples are finite; completing one is evidence about that sample, not proof that every possible number or phrase has been mastered.
